sources.label: Zdrgon's Morphe Patches including Direct-to-Cell Satellite Data Optimization
sources.author: Zdrgon
patch_list: Lets the patched app run: replaces PairIP's VM startup with harvested vault/handle data and removes the signature check and license dialog. Requires 'Disable PairIP protection (runtime files)'. DroidCam 9.0 only.
Swaps the VM-encrypted native libraries (libmjpg, libmdns) for decrypted builds that 'Disable PairIP protection' needs. Enable both together. DroidCam 9.0 only.
Unlocks DroidCam Pro (HD/4K, no watermark, all options): the license verdict is forced to Pro and renews itself at every silent re-check. Requires 'Disable PairIP protection'. DroidCam 9.0 only.
